messages.author: 9a88613f54ea8688
messages.subject: list of vectors
parts:
Hi group

Is there any plans for support of lists of vectors of uneven sizes? You can see a matrix as a list of vectors, each of which having the same length, but what if you input data, for example, consists of different cases each having a varying number of observations? The only solution I found so far is to put all the data in a large vector and carry along a second array that indicates the starting position of the different cases. That is error-prone and ugly.

thanks

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] list of vectors
parts:
We've thought about it for a long time. Here's an open issue with some of the implementation difficulties: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1369

Carrying around a second index is one of the ways to do this now. We don't have a timeline for when it'll get into the language. 


Daniel
